title: Numerical Smoothness and Error Analysis for Evolution Equations
summary: This is a lecture note to introduce the innovative concept of numerical smoothness and its application in the error analysis of numerical solutions of evolution equations. We start from the two fundamentally different error splittings. One splitting is popular, which brings us to local error defined along the original solution and error propagation by numerical schemes. The well know Lax Equivalence Theorem is based on this error splitting.
